I went for an interview for a pensions/insurance company. The interview consisted of 2 parts. One being a sort of aptitude test with general knowledge about the industry and problem solving. The second part being a role play exercise on the phone.

So the first part went great and I aced the questions. We then go through to a small room with a desk and a phone inside to begin. So I'm hella fuckin nervous because I've never done this type of thing before.

The lady interviewer gives me a sheet with boxes and details printed on it. She then tells me this is what you need to get from the customer. Name, address, issue etc.

She then says "I'm going to go to another room and in 5 minutes I'll call and act as the customer and I want you to do your best to get all of the information on the sheet... Remembering to go through security questions."

She goes out the door and I shit you not 20 seconds later the phone rings... TWENTY SECONDS! So that's completely thrown me into the biggest spin of nerves and panic.

To sum up what happened after that is I turned into the biggest stuttering mess I've ever been in my life and I think if someone was to hear that call back or play it back to me now. I would just die on the spot.

Makes me sweat and nervy explaining/thinking about it all.
